shell.down: Can't reach the modalfs background process. Retrying…
shell.downFirstP: The background process that holds your mounts isn't answering. Start it with `modalfs daemon`, or open the modalfs app.
shell.crashed: This page ran into a problem
shell.crashedP: Your mounts are fine; only this view stopped. Reload to try again.
shell.offline: Can't reach the modalfs background process
shell.noToken: This page needs the link `modalfs ui` opens; a bookmark or a copied address doesn't have its key. Run `modalfs ui` to get a fresh one.

mounts.title: Mounts
mounts.sub: Modal Volumes as local folders. No Modal compute involved.
mounts.emptyP: Pick a volume and modalfs puts it in a folder on this computer.
mounts.emptyNoAccount: Add a Modal account first, then pick a volume to mount.
mounts.autoMountD: Mount when modalfs starts. Pairs well with Start at login.
mounts.filterJunkD: .DS_Store and ._* files stay in memory and are never uploaded.
mounts.removeP: modalfs forgets this mount. The volume and its files are untouched.
mounts.stalled: nothing sent in the last minute; still trying
mounts.stopWaits: It unmounts once your changes are on Modal.
mounts.stopBackground: Folder unmounted; uploading the rest in the background.
mounts.nowP: The folder is unmounted right away, even if apps have files open in it. Changes that aren't on Modal yet stay saved on this computer: modalfs keeps uploading them in the background, and if it quits first, it uploads the rest the next time you mount this volume.
mounts.busyTitle: Couldn't unmount: something is using it
mounts.busyP: Close the files and folders open there, then try again. Or force the unmount.
mounts.forceApps: {{apps}} may show errors and lose changes they haven't saved.
mounts.forceAppsUnknown: Apps with files open in it may show errors and lose changes they haven't saved.
mounts.forceUploaded: Everything modalfs had is already on Modal.
mounts.forcePending: Changes that aren't on Modal yet stay saved on this computer and keep uploading in the background.

volumes.title: Volumes
volumes.sub: Create, rename and delete volumes. The Modal dashboard can't do this yet.
volumes.emptyP: Create a volume, then mount it.
volumes.v1: v1 volume. modalfs can only mount v2.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.sub: Links downloaded straight into a volume by Modal, which keeps going while this computer sleeps or is off.
downloads.turnOnD: Each download runs in a Modal Function in your workspace, billed to that account while it runs: about ${{price}} an hour at the smallest size, plus Modal's network charges. Mounting volumes never starts compute; only downloads you add do.
downloads.emptyP: Paste a link and pick a folder in a volume. Modal downloads it there, and you can close this computer meanwhile.
downloads.emptyNoAccount: Add a Modal account first, under Accounts.
downloads.addP: Modal downloads the links into the volume; the files appear in the folder when they're complete.
downloads.linksHint: http, https, ftp or magnet. One per line: each becomes a download of its own.
downloads.notALink: {{link}} isn't a link (http://, https://, ftp:// or magnet:)
downloads.noFolders: No folders yet: the download goes at the top of the volume.
downloads.folderNew: A new folder: it's made when the download finishes.

toolHint.auto: yt-dlp for video sites, gopeed for everything else.
toolHint.gopeed: Fast, with many connections at once. On some servers it fails; then aria2 takes over by itself.
toolHint.aria2: Steady and widely used, also for BitTorrent.
toolHint.yt-dlp: For video and audio pages, such as YouTube. Updated to the latest version for each download.

downloads.sizeHint: A bigger container costs more and rarely downloads faster.
downloads.cookiesHint: For yt-dlp, a cookies.txt for sites that want a sign-in. It's sent with the download and not kept.
downloads.cookiesLoaded: {{name}} is sent with the download and not kept.
downloads.costNote: This runs in a Modal Function in {{workspace}}: about ${{price}} an hour while it downloads ({{size}}), billed to that account. It stops when the download ends or is paused.
downloads.cancelP: The download stops and what it downloaded so far is deleted from the volume. Files it already finished stay.
downloads.keepPartial: Keep the partial download, to resume it later
downloads.removeP: Its records and anything partly downloaded are deleted from the volume.
downloads.removeDoneP: The downloaded files stay in the volume; only the download's records are deleted.

chart.hint: Point at the line for the acceleration there

downloads.recordsError: Couldn't read all of its records: {{error}}

ev.preempted: Modal stopped the container, as it sometimes does to move work around. The download continued {{gap}} later on a new one, keeping the {{done}} it had.
ev.preemptedNow: Modal stopped the container, as it sometimes does to move work around, with {{done}} saved. It continues on a new one shortly.
ev.lost: The container was lost without warning. The download continued {{gap}} later on a new one, from {{done}}.
ev.handover: Reached the Function's 24-hour limit and continued in a new one {{gap}} later.
ev.handoverNow: Reached the Function's 24-hour limit; continuing in a new one.
ev.error_one: {{tool}} reported an error, and the download was continued: {{message}}
ev.error_other: {{tool}} reported the same error {{count}} times, and the download was continued each time: {{message}}
ev.fallback: gopeed couldn't continue, so {{tool}} took over. It starts the file over.
ev.stallKick: No data for {{time}}, so the connections were opened again.
ev.stallStop: No data for {{time}}, so it stopped rather than keep the Function running for nothing.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.sub: Each mount is pinned to its own account, whatever profile the Modal CLI has active.
accounts.emptyP: Paste a Modal API token, or copy one from the Modal CLI's config.
accounts.removeP: Its saved mounts are removed too. Volumes on Modal are untouched.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyP: Uploads, conflicts and mounts show up here as they happen.
activity.loadFailedP: Trying again with the next update.

ev.conflict: {{a0}} changed on Modal while you edited it. Your version is saved as {{a1}}
ev.follow_rename: Volume renamed {{a0}} → {{a1}}; the mount follows it
ev.stale_cleaned: Cleaned up a stale mount at {{a0}}
ev.unmounted_forced: {{a0}} was in use ({{a1}}), so it was unmounted by force
ev.unmounted_forced_noapps: {{a0}} was in use, so it was unmounted by force
ev.unmount_busy_noapps: Couldn't unmount {{a0}}: something is using it
ev.upload_left: Some changes couldn't be uploaded yet. They're kept on this computer and uploaded the next time it's mounted: {{a0}}
ev.automount_retry: Couldn't mount yet ({{a0}}); trying again in {{a1}} s
ev.quit_now: Quitting without waiting for uploads. The rest is uploaded the next time each volume is mounted
ev.service_updated: Start at login ran {{a0}}, which is gone; it now runs {{a1}}
ev.pending_kept_ro: Changes from an earlier session are kept on this computer and are uploaded the next time this volume is mounted with write access
ev.dl_preparing: Preparing the downloader in your Modal workspace (when modalfs is new or updated)
ev.dl_interrupted: Modal stopped the container downloading {{a0}}; it continues on a new one from what it saved
ev.dl_continued: {{a0}} reached the Function's 24-hour limit and continues in a new one
ev.dl_stalled: {{a0}} stopped: the server sent nothing for too long. Resume it to try again
ev.dl_time_limit: {{a0}} paused at the Function's time limit. Resume it to continue
ev.dl_stop_failed: Couldn't stop {{a0}}: {{a1}}. It may still be running in your Modal workspace
ev.dl_stopped_hard: The container downloading {{a0}} didn't answer, so it was stopped at once. Resuming continues from its last saved state

settings.title: Settings
settings.loginD: Runs in the background after you log in, so auto-mounts are there without opening the window.
settings.cacheD: {{used}} of {{max}}. Shared by all volumes; identical data is stored once.
settings.cacheSmall: Below {{n}} GB, read-ahead and files you reopen are often downloaded again.
settings.cacheSizeD: Any whole number of GB from {{min}}. We recommend at least {{n}} GB, and more if you read many large files at once. Unsaved writes are kept on disk separately and don't count toward this.
settings.cacheSizeBad: Enter a whole number of at least {{min}}.
settings.clearP: Cached blocks are downloaded again when they're next read. Unsaved changes aren't affected.
settings.readAheadD: 8 MiB blocks fetched ahead during sequential reads.
settings.mountRootD: New mounts go in a folder named after the volume inside this one.
settings.transportD: Change this only behind a proxy that allows HTTP/1.1 and nothing else.
settings.quitD: Uploads pending changes, unmounts every volume and stops the background process.
settings.quitP: Each volume is unmounted once its changes are on Modal. You'll see the progress, and can quit sooner if you need to.
settings.loginMissing: It runs {{path}}, which isn't there anymore. Quit modalfs and open it again from where it is now to fix this.
settings.remoteDownloadsD: Each download you add runs in a Modal Function in that account's workspace and is billed to it while it runs. Mounting never starts compute.
settings.downloadSizeD: A bigger container costs more and rarely downloads faster. Small suits most links.
settings.stallD: A server that stops sending would otherwise keep the Function running, and billed, for nothing.

quit.title: Quitting modalfs…
quit.sub: Each volume is unmounted once its changes are on Modal.
quit.nowP: Quit now unmounts everything at once and stops uploading. Changes that aren't on Modal yet stay saved on this computer and are uploaded the next time you mount each volume.
quit.doneP: Your volumes are unmounted. Open modalfs again to mount them.

form.label: Name
form.tokenHint: Create a token at modal.com → Settings → API Tokens. The secret is kept in the Keychain.
form.volNameHint: Letters, digits, . _ and -, up to 64. Creates a v2 volume.
form.volNameBad: Use letters, digits, . _ and -, starting with a letter or digit.
form.newMountP: Pick an account and a volume.
form.noFreeVolumes: Every v2 volume here is already mounted
form.deleteP: Every file in this volume is deleted for good. This can't be undone.
form.importP: Copies the token into modalfs, so switching the Modal CLI's profile later never moves your mounts.
